description.value: The Starbucks at Dilworth Plaza sits on Highway 97 North, one of Kelowna's main commercial arterials, making it a natural rest stop for cyclists traveling through the Okanagan corridor. The location is drive-through enabled and offers the full Starbucks menu of espresso drinks, teas, Refreshers, and packaged food items. OSM records outdoor seating, giving road-weary riders a place to sit and refuel off the busy highway.
